chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Giuffre brings the Four Brothers chart to rehearsal
summary: At the new band's rehearsal studio, Giuffre showed up with the chart; they recorded it on their first Columbia date in California.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Do you want to describe then how Jimmy came and gave you the chart, and how it happened and all? He brought it for rehearsal or --

Yeah, well, we were in the throes of organizing the band, and we had actually -- one of the few times in my life we had a rehearsal studio, and we were all assembled there. Guys came in from all over the country and during this whole melee, Giuffre showed up with this chart.

Yeah. Ralph was writing while we were rehearsing, and all this sort of thing. And we evidently got it really right over, because I think it was the first date we did with that band for Columbia, here in California. We did the Four Brothers, along with some other tunes. Right now, I just can't think which other things we did on the same date.
